_doc: Exact spec + full describe/title quarantine; the title identifies the affected backend or viewport suite.
Only this known test may pass on retry. Other tests in the spec remain blocking.
owner is the accountable GitHub user; evidence links the observed failed run.
expires is inclusive UTC; after this date flakes block again. Review before expiry using the measured exit criteria; never extend automatically.
Missing or invalid policy fields fail closed. The spec still gets an isolated retrying shard while its exact-test policy is active.

signature (optional; required on rows since 2026-10-26): a case-sensitive regex source starting with ^, matched against the retried attempt's first error line with ANSI codes and a leading 'Error: ' removed (flaky-policy.mjs errorLine). The row then exempts only that failure; the same test failing with any other message still blocks. Several rows may name one spec, one per exact title.

quarantine.title: loading circuits one after another keeps one world in memory and does not grow
quarantine.review: Issue #7464 (map-switch slowdown). Metal real-GPU job only, a GC sawtooth that passes on retry 1. (1) PR #7007 20197e3f (run 45881964604 job 140123810793): monaco heap 131.7 → 133.4 → 151.3 → 134.7 → 152.1 MB (median growth 17.489 > 10); #7007 allocates nothing. (2) PR #7480 5d120c54 (run 46109757702 job 140870601140): monza heap 122.1 → 126.0 → 151.9 → 127.6 → 154.5 MB (median growth 25.92 > 10, 106.1 s retry); #7480 (VSC drill) touches no renderer or track loading. Metal ~17 MB per pick is documented in docs/notes/TRACK-SWITCH-METAL-2026-10-17.md. Exit: #7464 lands a fix (or re-bounds the Metal check), then three cold CI passes of this spec without retry, then remove this row; an extension needs a fresh failed run and a new deadline.
quarantine.why: Two reds, two circuits, one shape: #7007 20197e3f monaco series 17.8/-16.6/17.5; #7480 5d120c54 monza series 25.9/-24.3/26.9 (net after warm-up 28.5 MB). Both passed on retry; APEX_FAIL_ON_FLAKY=1 turned each retry into exit 1. Signature widened from ^monaco to monaco|monza on 2026-11-28; any other circuit still blocks.
